info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Prospect Campaign Design API
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Design API provides essential capabilities for retrieving specific design elements of marketing campaigns targeted at potential customers. By using this API, marketing teams can access detailed information and configurations of prospect campaigns, facilitating informed decision-making and strategic planning. This endpoint is primarily used by marketing professionals seeking to enhance their campaign effectiveness through data-driven insights. It supports various use cases, including the optimization of marketing strategies and the analysis of prospect engagement patterns.

get.summary: Retrieve details of the marketing prospect campaign design.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of a specific marketing prospect campaign design identified by its unique resource ID. It provides essential information relevant to the campaign, enabling users to make informed decisions regarding their marketing strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a specific marketing prospect campaign design identified by RES-100045. It may include parameters relevant for the GET operation, allowing for a tailored response based on the campaign's unique attributes or settings.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the prospect campaign design.

GetMarketingProspectCampaignDesignRes100.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for the GET operation related to the prospect campaign design.
